$comment: Recorded LLM steps (node.started input + node.finished usage/output) as each adapter puts them on the wire, for the W5 Context & cost tests. CURRENT (0.6.0, contract C1) entries were captured on 2026-09-25 from master cd8d240 by driving each adapter through its own test fakes and recording what the fake viewer received: aiSdk (ai@7 streamText + MockLanguageModel, 3 steps), anthropicTs (real @anthropic-ai/sdk client over a scripted fetch, 3 turns, cache breakpoint moved to the newest message every turn), openaiChat / openaiResponses (real openai client over a scripted fetch), langgraphTs (a real LangGraph StateGraph ReAct loop with gm.handler()), python* (python/graphmind integrations through the real anthropic / openai SDKs over httpx.MockTransport, and a LangChain chat model), rubyOpenAI (ruby-openai over a Faraday test adapter) and rubyLlm (ruby_llm, identical on 1.x and 2.x). LEGACY entries are what the 0.5 senders recorded (captured 2026-09-23 on master 3ba874e; legacyDemoAiSdk is the bundled demo recording packages/cli/src/demo/fixture-data.ts; legacyPythonTrimmed / legacyRubyTrimmed are the 0.5 ports' preview trims) — old histories still hold them. otlpImport / openInference: packages/cli/test/fixtures/*.expected.json.
